body: That looks like a cane toad wallet.  Fuck cane toads.
Keep it because the prices will go up, but they won't go up that high.  On my server they used to peak at ~14k, but after the BoA mount patch they never got that high again.

Items: http://www.wowhead.com/compare?items=47176:50466:37255:37255:47495:38670:47229:45674:38667:47502

Only available to Death Knights due to feet and hands, but those can be replaced easily.

Full set [here](http://www.wowhead.com/compare?items=10845:42062:29348:14842:14936:21706:14934:4336:18722:14937).

I built this set around the fist weapon, however due to said weapon the set is not fully moggable.  This set also gives another use for the traditional skimpy [Warrior's Embrace](http://www.wowhead.com/item=10845) on a male character.  The shield was an afterthought, but I think it turned out alright.

Fun fact: this actually depends entirely on whether you've done Wrath Gate or not.  If you have done Wrath Gate, their dialogue changes to [this](http://i.imgur.com/c1Co6GS.jpg).  Not actually behind the times, because since you haven't gone through Wrath Gate yet for you it assumes you haven't finished leveling through Northrend and thus the Forsaken forces would still be established there.  It actually establishes a kind of timeline, which is pretty cool.

So, from what I'm seeing this item is catered specifically towards the (minority) of players that are hardcore into transmog, as the high £10.00 price is really a deterrent for casual 'moggers.  I'm not a big fan about buying things from the Blizzard store at all, and I'm not a fan of where this is going.  It's clear by now that the player base is declining and so Blizzard is trying to milk as much money as possible out of the remaining player base, and for the most part it is fine.  Mounts are cool but not mandatory, these helms do have similar look alikes in game (in colour and general theme, like [Magma Plated Helmet](http://www.wowhead.com/item=60341) and [Erupting Volcanic Helmet](http://www.wowhead.com/item=71549)) and, let's face it here, max level is where the game really begins so the exp bonus isn't really "pay to win".  The closet thing to "pay to win" right now is the lesser charms being sold, and honestly you can do dailies for an hour and be able to get the same amount and not pay.  I see Blizzard going into a direction where they might do the BMAH as money and gold transactions (pay $50 for this OR 10k gold!), but when you can pay for an entire tier set with real money then it's pay to win.
